description: Shared definitions for the research outputs of Slop University.

outputClass.description: The University's classification of a research output.

researchPoster.description: A research poster: a single-sheet presentation of a study's question, method and principal findings, prepared for display at a conference, a symposium or the University's own corridors.

marketingPoster.description: A promotional poster issued by a school or unit of the University, directing the attention of prospective students and partners to a program of study or research.

paper.description: A research paper: a written account of an original study, its methods, results and discussion, issued by the University under its own identifier.

brochure.description: A brochure describing a school, program or initiative of the University to prospective students, partners and the wider community.

strategy.description: An institutional strategic plan, setting out the University's priorities, commitments and measures of success over a plan period.

impactReport.description: An impact report, recording what a school or unit of the University has delivered against its stated priorities and the difference that work is understood to have made.

thesis.description: A doctoral thesis: an extended original contribution to knowledge, submitted by a candidate of the University and examined under its delegated authority.

videoExplainer.description: A research explainer video, in which a researcher of the University presents the question, approach and findings of one of its outputs.

videoPromo.description: A promotional video presenting a researcher, a school or the University itself to prospective students, partners and the public.
